name: hivebrite-api-migration
description: Migrate code that calls the Hivebrite Admin API v1, v2 or v3 (switched off on 15 February 2027) to v3.1, or straight to v4, in any language: scans for every legacy call, rewrites authentication and endpoints, applies the response changes that fail silently, and proves the result with a re-scan, a sandbox smoke test and a response-shape comparison.
